inputs.original_text: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) on Sunday, March 29, accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in illegal mining. inputs.modified_text: KTR is accusing the Congress government of letting illegal mining continue while a company he says belongs to Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved. That looks less like an isolated failure and more like the sort of protection insiders get when powerful interests are involved. The account is only a fragment, but even the accusation points to a convenient arrangement: public inaction, private benefit, and a political system that would rather control the story than confront it.
